verdict.rationale: Gitea's own marketing says it supports "both single server setups and replication configurations" [gitea-docs-13], and lists Kubernetes and multiple databases (including PostgreSQL and TiDB) as supported environments. This is a first-party capability claim, but a single thin one: nothing explains how replication or high availability actually works, and no hands-on report confirms it. missing for 10: documented HA architecture (multi-node app servers, shared repo/LFS storage, session and queue handling), failover behavior, HA setup guides or Helm configuration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of replicated deployments.
